steps.name: all-quality-unit-type-budget-and-Android-debug-BLE-card
steps.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "CODE_SOURCE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
uptime
echo 'FULL_CHECK_START'
pnpm check >/tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-182-check.log 2>&1 || {
 echo 'PNPM_CHECK_FAILED'
 grep -E 'FAIL|Error|Tests |Test Files|budget' /tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-182-check.log | tail -85 || true
 tail -80 /tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-182-check.log
 exit 50
}
echo 'PNPM_CHECK_PASS'
grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |Performance budget|Performance review|threshold exceeded|budget passed' /tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-182-check.log | tail -54 || true
echo 'CAPACITOR_SYNC'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android
SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"
test -d "$SDK"
printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties
(cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --quiet)
APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
test -s "$APK"
echo "APK_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "APK_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$APK" | tr -d ' ')"
echo 'WORKTREE';git status --short
uptime
